title: Adding, Verifying and Taking Off a Plan — Prescription Insurance on File Desk Guidance
content:
**Prescription Insurance on File** records a plan from the member card and keeps it pending until eligibility is confirmed. The desk applies the following rules.

## Adding a plan

- A plan is added from the card details the patient reads out, copied exactly: payer name, the 6-digit BIN, the PCN, the group number, the member ID, the 2-digit person code, the cardholder relationship (self, spouse or dependent), the billing order (primary or secondary) and the plan effective date from the card or the eligibility response.
- Every plan starts in pending verification.
- A dependent is added only where the class covers dependents and the patient's age in whole years on the day of adding is no more than the class's highest dependent age.
- A workers' compensation plan is added only when the patient states the employer's injury claim number, where the class requires that number. The claim number is taken from the patient's own statement.

## Becoming active

The plan becomes active when the payer's eligibility response or a paid claim confirms that the patient is covered.

## Removing a plan still pending

A pending plan whose eligibility is still unconfirmed is removed no earlier than the date the plan was added plus the class's eligibility verification days, counted in calendar days with the adding date as day 0. The adding date is read from the coverage record, and the removal date may fall on that last day or any later day.

| Day of removal (counting the adding date as day 0), class with 14 verification days | May the unconfirmed plan be removed? |
|---|---|
| day 13 | No |
| day 14 | Yes |
| day 20 | Yes |

*Hypothetical:* a plan added on 3 June under a class with 14 verification days may be removed, if still unconfirmed, on 17 June or later, and not on 16 June.

## Taking off an active plan

An active plan is taken off the profile only at the patient's own request, which the patient confirms themselves. Kestrel never removes an active plan on its own initiative.

## Dependent age check (hypothetical)

Under a class that covers dependents to age 26, a dependent aged 26 on the day of adding may be added; a dependent aged 27 on that day may not. Under a class that does not cover dependents, no dependent is added at any age.
